title: NightWatch Error Envelope
description: Unified error envelope (WorkRequest §5.4): {code, message, details, retryable, idempotent_replay}. The 'code' enum mirrors the registry in nightwatch/schemas/errors.json; the verifier enforces bidirectional equality between this enum and the registry keys. idempotent_replay=true marks a response that replays a previously recorded result for the same idempotency key.

code.description: Registry code; full semantics/HTTP mapping/default retryable live in errors.json.

message.description: Human-readable message; must not contain secret material.

details.description: Optional structured details (e.g. schema path, conflicting idempotency key).

retryable.description: Whether the caller may retry (should match the registry default unless overridden by policy).

idempotent_replay.description: True when this response replays a previously recorded result for the same idempotency key.
